# Ananke

> .NET 10 library for AI agent orchestration. Build workflows, agents, tools, and multi-agent systems with a fluent C# API and optional YAML manifest topology.

This is the extended reference for LLMs. It includes detailed API summaries, key types, error codes, and pattern descriptions alongside all documentation links.

---

## Core Concepts

### Workflow

`Workflow<TState>` is the primary builder. `TState` is a C# record that carries all state between jobs.

```csharp
var workflow = new Workflow<MyState>("name")
    .Job("step_a", async (state, ct) => state with { A = "done" })
    .Job("step_b", async (state, ct) => state with { B = "done" })
    .Then("step_a", "step_b")
    .RunAsync(initialState, cancellationToken);
```

Key builder methods:
- `.Job(name, func)` — register an async job
- `.Job(name, IJob<TState>)` — register an `IJob<TState>` implementation
- `.Then(from, to)` — direct connection
- `.Fork(from, to[])` — fan-out to parallel branches
- `.Join(from[], to, mergeFunc)` — fan-in from parallel branches
- `.SubFlow(name, innerWorkflow, mapIn, mapOut)` — embed a nested workflow
- `.Decide(name, func, branches)` — conditional routing with a predicate
- `.DecideWithAgent(name, agentJob, branches)` — LLM-driven routing
- `.Interrupt(name, InterruptMode.Before | After)` — mark a job for human review
- `.RunAsync(state, ct)` — execute

### AgentJob

Wraps an `IStreamingAgentModel` as a workflow job with a system prompt, user prompt template, optional tools, and typed response mapping.

```csharp
var agentJob = new AgentJob<MyState, MyResponse>(
    name: "analyze",
    model: openAiModel,
    systemPrompt: "You are an analyst.",
    userPrompt: s => $"Analyze: {s.Input}",
    tools: myToolKit,
    mapResponse: (state, response) => state with { Result = response.Analysis }
);
```

### ToolKit

Groups named functions for LLM tool-calling.

```csharp
var tools = new ToolKit("my-tools")
    .Add("search_web", "Search the web for recent information",
        new { query = new ToolParameter<string>("Search query") },
        async (p, ct) => ToolResult.Ok(await SearchAsync(p.query)));
```

### IStreamingAgentModel / Providers

| Interface | Package | Type |
|-----------|---------|------|
| `IStreamingAgentModel` | `Ananke.Orchestration` | Base interface |
| `OpenAIStreamingModel` | `Ananke.Orchestration.OpenAI` | OpenAI / Azure |
| `AnthropicStreamingModel` | `Ananke.Orchestration.Anthropic` | Claude |
| `GoogleStreamingModel` | `Ananke.Orchestration.Google` | Gemini |
| `SimulatedModel` | `Ananke.Orchestration` | Testing (no API keys) |

### Design DSL

`Ananke.Design` separates topology (text) from behavior (code).

```ananke-dsl
plan -> fork(fetch_a, fetch_b)
join(fetch_a, fetch_b) -> combine
combine -> End
```

Parse and bind:
```csharp
var scaffold = WorkflowScaffold.Parse<MyState>(dslLines);
scaffold.Bind("plan", planJob).Bind("fetch_a", fetchAJob)...;
var workflow = scaffold.Build();
```

YAML manifest (`.ananke.yml`):
```yaml
name: my-pipeline
models:
  default: { provider: openai, model: gpt-4o }
jobs:
  plan: agent
  fetch_a: code
  fetch_b: code
  combine: agent
connections:
  - plan -> fork(fetch_a, fetch_b)
  - join(fetch_a, fetch_b) -> combine
  - combine -> End
```

DSL connection syntax:

| Syntax | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `a -> b` | Direct connection from a to b |
| `a -> fork(b, c)` | Fan-out: a dispatches to b and c in parallel |
| `join(b, c) -> d` | Fan-in: d runs after both b and c complete |
| `a -> router(b, c, d)` | Dynamic routing via `IRouter<T>` |
| `interrupt(name)` | Mark job `name` for human review |
| `a -> End` | Terminate workflow |

---

## Agentic Patterns

Pre-wired builders in `AgenticPattern`:

### ReviewCritique
```csharp
var workflow = AgenticPattern.ReviewCritique<ReviewState>("review")
    .WithGenerator(generatorAgent)
    .WithCritic(criticAgent)
    .Until(s => s.Score >= 0.9)
    .MaxIterations(6)
    .Build();
```
State: `{ Draft, Score, Feedback, Topic }`

### IterativeRefinement
```csharp
var workflow = AgenticPattern.IterativeRefinement<RefinementState>("refine")
    .WithRefiner(refinerAgent)
    .Until(s => s.QualityScore >= threshold)
    .MaxIterations(5)
    .Build();
```
State: `{ Output, QualityScore, Iteration }`

### Router
```csharp
var workflow = AgenticPattern.Router<RouterState>("route")
    .WithClassifier(classifierAgent)
    .AddBranch("technical", techAgent)
    .AddBranch("billing", billingAgent)
    .Build();
```
State: `{ Input, Category, Response }`

### Handoff
```csharp
var workflow = AgenticPattern.Handoff<HandoffState>("triage")
    .WithTriage(triageAgent)
    .HandoffTo<SpecialistState>(channel, mapIn, mapOut)
    .Build();
```

---

## CLI Tooling — `nnke`

Install: `dotnet tool install -g nnke`

### Commands

| Command | Output | Purpose |
|---------|--------|---------|
| `nnke new workflow <name> --pattern <p>` | Files | Scaffold a complete runnable project |
| `nnke new workflow <name> --pattern <p> --json` | JSON | Machine-readable scaffold report |
| `nnke validate <file>` | Text | Validate `.ananke.yml` topology |
| `nnke validate <file> --json` | JSON | Structured validation result |
| `nnke inspect <dir> --json` | JSON | Full project health report |
| `nnke docs <topic> --json` | JSON | Read a documentation topic |
| `nnke docs --search "<q>" --json` | JSON | Search documentation with snippets |
| `nnke explain <code> --json` | JSON | Explain a diagnostic error code |
| `nnke patterns --json` | JSON | List all available patterns |
| `nnke patterns <name> --json` | JSON | Pattern details with API example |
| `nnke schema` | JSON | Full command catalog (agent self-discovery) |
| `nnke mcp-server` | stdio | Run as MCP server |

### Available Patterns

| Pattern | Style | Topology |
|---------|-------|---------|
| `sequential` | manifest | `a -> b -> c -> End` |
| `etl` | manifest | `extract -> fork(a, b) -> join -> combine -> End` |
| `fan-out` | manifest | `dispatch -> fork(a, b, c) -> join -> merge -> End` |
| `human-in-the-loop` | manifest | `process -> interrupt(review) -> publish -> End` |
| `sub-workflow` | manifest | `prep -> subflow(inner) -> publish -> End` |
| `review-critique` | code | Generator ↔ Critic loop until approved |
| `iterative-refinement` | code | Single-agent self-refine loop |
| `router` | code | LLM-driven decision routing |
| `handoff` | code | Delegate to external agent, await response |

### Diagnostic Error Codes

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|------|---------|-----|
| `ANANKE_TOPO_001` | Unreachable job | Ensure every job has at least one incoming connection |
| `ANANKE_TOPO_002` | No path to `End` | All branches must terminate at `End` |
| `ANANKE_TOPO_003` | Fork without matching join | Add `join(a, b) -> next` before the merge point |
| `ANANKE_TOPO_004` | Undefined job referenced in connection | Declare the job in `jobs:` |
| `ANANKE_MODEL_001` | Model alias not defined in `models:` | Add alias to `models:` block |
| `ANANKE_MANIFEST_001` | YAML parse error | Check `.ananke.yml` syntax |

---

## Memory

### Long-Term Memory (Knowledge)

```csharp
var processor = new DocumentProcessor(extractor, chunker, embedder, store);
await processor.IngestAsync(document, ct);
var results = await store.SearchAsync("query text", topK: 5, ct);
```

Interfaces: `IDocumentExtractor`, `IDocumentChunker`, `IEmbeddingModel`, `IKnowledgeStore`
In-memory impl: `InMemoryKnowledgeStore`
Qdrant impl: `QdrantKnowledgeStore` (`Ananke.Memory.Qdrant`)

### Empirical Memory

Three kinds: `EmpiricalKind.Pattern`, `EmpiricalKind.Skill`, `EmpiricalKind.Heuristic`

```csharp
var tools = new EmpiricalMemoryTools(empiricalMemory);
// Exposes: recall_empirical, commit_insight, reinforce_empirical
```

Interface: `IEmpiricalMemory`
In-memory impl: `InMemoryEmpiricalMemory`
Qdrant impl: `QdrantEmpiricalMemory` (`Ananke.Learning`)
